description: Returns OHLCV candles computed from trade history. All prices are YES-normalized, and buckets with no trades are omitted (sparse series). Without `from`, the response contains the newest `limit` candles ending at `to`. With `from`, candles are returned forward from that timestamp; if the requested window exceeds the bucket cap, the response contains the oldest `limit` candles and `coverage.complete` is false. For a capped explicit-from page, response `to` is the next candle's start and is an exclusive continuation boundary. Response `from` and `to` describe the window actually served. An explicit `from` or `to` is floored to the selected resolution's candle boundary; a range whose floored end is not after its floored start returns 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`. Pass `tournamentId` for one explicit accessible tournament. When an organization-bound key omits it, the request uses the organization's default tournament; an unbound key uses public-global trade history.

schema.description: When provided, returns candles computed from that accessible tournament's trades. Omit for the organization's default tournament with an organization-bound key or public-global history with an unbound key.

parameters.description: When provided, returns candles computed from that accessible tournament's trades. Omit for the organization's default tournament with an organization-bound key or public-global history with an unbound key.
parameters.name: tournamentId

schema.description: Candle size. Buckets are aligned to UTC multiples of the resolution measured from the Unix epoch, so `1w` buckets begin on Thursdays.

parameters.description: Candle size. Buckets are aligned to UTC multiples of the resolution measured from the Unix epoch, so `1w` buckets begin on Thursdays.
parameters.name: resolution

schema.description: ISO-8601 start timestamp (inclusive). Floored down to the selected resolution's bucket boundary; the response `from` reflects the floored value. When omitted, returns the newest candles up to `to`.

parameters.description: ISO-8601 start timestamp (inclusive). Floored down to the selected resolution's bucket boundary; the response `from` reflects the floored value. When omitted, returns the newest candles up to `to`.
parameters.name: from

schema.description: ISO-8601 end timestamp (exclusive). When supplied, floored down to the selected resolution's bucket boundary. Defaults to now (not floored).

parameters.description: ISO-8601 end timestamp (exclusive). When supplied, floored down to the selected resolution's bucket boundary. Defaults to now (not floored).
parameters.name: to

schema.description: Maximum number of candles to return (max 1000). Selects the newest candles when `from` is omitted and the oldest candles forward from an explicit `from`.

parameters.description: Maximum number of candles to return (max 1000). Selects the newest candles when `from` is omitted and the oldest candles forward from an explicit `from`.
parameters.name: limit

complete.description: False only when an explicit `from` window was truncated by the candle limit.

projectedThroughSequence.description: Latest trading-engine sequence these candles are complete through — the lower of the reporting projection's position and the event-ingest position, since both write this store. Null when either has no checkpoint, including on a deployment the engine has never touched.
